summary: Iteration 6 (LIVE gateway validation): 5/5 pytest tests passed. Real Vertex AI Agent Engine plan flow via Cloud Run gateway is fully connected. POST /api/experiences + POST /api/experiences/{id}/plan returned HTTP 200 in 31.8s with a bilingual title (en+es), 6 beats, and 8 missions. Trace provenance confirms director (14344ms) and cinematographer (17320ms) both ran on service='vertex-agent-engine', status='ok', model='agent-engine'; context ran on service='parallel' with status='not_connected' (Parallel key not set — expected). Regression health (agent, partner, auth/me) all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: agent_adapter._gateway sends session_id=None so the engine creates a fresh session per call — good for correctness but adds session-create round-trip latency; consider caching a per-user session_id (see gateway response.session_id) to reduce plan latency below ~30s if desired.
Director+cinematographer are called sequentially (~14s + ~17s = ~31s). Since they are independent given the same intent, running them in parallel via asyncio.gather could halve plan latency.
test_live_gateway_plan.py fixture uses instance-method class scope; PytestRemovedIn10Warning — cosmetic, migrate to @classmethod before pytest 10.
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral experience 'TEST_LUMIERE live-gateway' (Barcelona, 2 days) created in mongo; planned via LIVE Vertex Agent Engine. Left in DB with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LIVE gateway is stable. Plan takes ~30s (director ~14s + cinematographer ~17s sequential); use timeout>=90s. Response shape: {plan:{title:{en,es}, beats:[...], missions:[...]}}. agent-runs shape: dict keyed by agent name ('context'|'director'|'cinematographer') with fields service/status/model/latency_ms. Parallel is intentionally not_connected (no PARALLEL_API_KEY).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Prior 'AgentEngine has no attribute query' + 'session_id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' issues are resolved: gateway/_query() uses create_session/get_session+stream_query and adapter sends session_id=None so the engine mints a valid one. Confirmed live: 2 agent-runs on service='vertex-agent-engine' with status='ok' and positive latency_ms.
